extension.description: Scrobbles your Kodi playback to your self-hosted Chronicle server, and syncs ratings, artwork, and watch counts both ways. Chronicle is the source of truth for ratings and art (always pushed to Kodi); play counts and last-played dates reconcile in whichever direction has the more recent watch. Covers movies, movie collections, TV shows, and individual episodes. Supports resetting Kodi watch progress for a fresh rewatch while keeping your full history safe in Chronicle.
extension.news: v2.0.1 - Fix: remove the xbmc.gui dependency declaration — it's not a real resolvable addon on modern Kodi (GUI functionality ships bundled with xbmc.python), and declaring it caused every install attempt to fail with "dependency on xbmc.gui version 5.14.0 could not be satisfied". v2.0.0 - Bidirectional sync: ratings + art (Chronicle -> Kodi, source of truth) and play count / last-played reconciliation (whichever side is more recent wins) for movies, movie collections, TV shows, and episodes. Scrobbling resolves/creates the Chronicle media item automatically when Chronicle hasn't matched it yet. v1.1.0 - QR code device authentication; sync Chronicle lists to Kodi playlists v1.0.0 - Initial release
